scenario.title: Round and null-guard the shared net_revenue macro
scenario.description: One macro edit silently changes every model that uses it (and their descendants). Cheap arithmetic; tests multi-model attribution and false positives.

consumers.sql: select * from {{ ref('rpt_customer_segments') }} order by customer_count desc
select * from {{ ref('rpt_daily_kpis') }} order by ship_date
select nation_name, ship_month, sum(net_revenue) as net_revenue from {{ ref('mart_revenue_by_nation') }} group by 1, 2

main.name: customer_ltv_monthly
main.sql:
with lines as (
    select
        o.customer_key,
        o.order_key,
        o.order_date,
        (l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount)) as revenue
    from "lab"."prod"."stg_orders" o
    join "lab"."prod"."stg_lineitem" l on l.order_key = o.order_key
    where o.order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
),
monthly as (
    select
        customer_key,
        date_trunc('month', order_date) as order_month,
        sum(revenue)              as revenue,
        count(distinct order_key) as order_count
    from lines
    group by 1, 2
)
select
    customer_key,
    order_month,
    revenue,
    order_count,
    sum(revenue) over (partition by customer_key order by order_month
                       rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_revenue,
    min(order_month) over (partition by customer_key)                     as cohort_month
from monthly

main.name: fct_daily_revenue
main.sql:
select
    l.ship_date,
    count(*)                                                 as line_count,
    sum(l.quantity)                                          as total_quantity,
    sum((l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount))) as net_revenue,
    sum(case when l.return_flag = 'R'
             then (l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount))
             else 0 end)                                     as returned_revenue
from "lab"."prod"."stg_lineitem" l
where l.ship_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)

  and l.ship_date > cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-3 as bigint) * interval 1 day) as date)

group by l.ship_date

main.name: int_order_lines
main.sql:
select
    l.order_key,
    l.line_number,
    l.part_key,
    l.supplier_key,
    o.customer_key,
    o.order_date,
    o.order_priority,
    l.ship_date,
    l.ship_mode,
    l.return_flag,
    l.quantity,
    l.extended_price,
    l.discount,
    (l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount)) as net_revenue,
    l.line_comment,
    o.order_comment
from "lab"."prod"."stg_lineitem" l
join "lab"."prod"."stg_orders" o on o.order_key = l.order_key
where l.ship_date > cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-180 as bigint) * interval 1 day) as date)
  and l.ship_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
  and l.return_flag <> 'R'

main.name: mart_part_profitability
main.sql:
select
    ol.part_key,
    pc.part_name,
    pc.brand,
    sum(ol.quantity)                                            as quantity_sold,
    sum(ol.net_revenue)                                         as net_revenue,
    sum(ol.net_revenue) - sum(ol.quantity * pc.min_supply_cost) as est_margin
from "lab"."ci_main"."int_order_lines" ol
join "lab"."prod"."part_supplier_costs" pc on pc.part_key = ol.part_key
group by ol.part_key, pc.part_name, pc.brand

main.name: mart_revenue_by_nation
main.sql:
select
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date) as ship_month,
    count(distinct ol.order_key)                    as order_count,
    sum(ol.net_revenue)                             as net_revenue
from "lab"."ci_main"."int_order_lines" ol
join "lab"."prod"."dim_customers" c on c.customer_key = ol.customer_key
group by 1, 2, 3
having date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date)
       >= date_trunc('month', cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-3 as bigint) * interval 1 month) as date))

main.name: rpt_daily_kpis
main.sql:
select
    ship_date,
    net_revenue,
    returned_revenue,
    line_count,
    avg(net_revenue) over (order by ship_date rows between 6 preceding and current row) as net_revenue_7d_avg
from "lab"."ci_main"."fct_daily_revenue"
where ship_date > cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-30 as bigint) * interval 1 day) as date)

main.name: bi_nation_trend
main.sql: select nation_name, ship_month, sum(net_revenue) as net_revenue from "lab"."ci_main"."mart_revenue_by_nation" group by 1, 2
